### Register and coordinate

- [ ] Agree the requested publication date (**{{publication_date}}**) with the Anthology and update the original answer. <!-- task:agree-publication when:current -->
- [ ] Confirm the complete volume roster, consistent titles, editors, venue identifiers, and SIGs, including workshops, in this issue ([metadata instructions](https://aclanthology.org/info/contrib/#register-your-meeting)). <!-- task:volume-roster context:submission -->
- [ ] Confirm whether the event is ACL-organized in the original answer so the appropriate ISBN instructions can be applied. <!-- task:clarify-affiliation when:unknown-affiliation -->
- [ ] Identify the proceedings platform or explain the "Other" export in Supporting Information and agree its handoff with the Anthology. <!-- task:clarify-platform when:unknown-platform -->
- [ ] Coordinate publication of this historical material with the Anthology; leave the publication date blank if it can be published immediately. <!-- task:historical-publication when:historical -->

### Prepare and deliver

- [ ] Request author ORCID iDs and verify that they appear in the delivered ingestion metadata, not just in submission-system profiles ([ORCID guidance](https://aclanthology.org/info/orcid/)). <!-- task:collect-orcids due:delivery when:current -->
- [ ] Agree the proceedings cutoff (**{{freeze_date}}** at the latest) and record any earlier agreed date in "Proceedings Cutoff Date". <!-- task:agree-cutoff when:current -->
- [ ] At the agreed cutoff, freeze all main and workshop volumes in one versioned snapshot, including PDFs, frontmatter, metadata, and attachments. <!-- task:freeze-snapshot due:freeze when:current context:submission -->
- [ ] Arrange applicable licensing permissions and include available copyright transfers with the proceedings; START handles its copyright process during camera-ready submission ([copyright instructions](https://aclanthology.org/info/contrib/#copyright)). <!-- task:copyright due:delivery -->
- [ ] Post an accessible link and exact version for the complete snapshot in this issue. Use a pinned commit or unmoved tag, or a distinctly versioned archive/folder. Give later updates a new version and list changed volumes/files; do not silently replace delivered files ([delivery instructions](https://aclanthology.org/info/contrib/#submit-your-data)). <!-- task:deliver-snapshot due:delivery context:submission -->
